notes.title: Demo Patch Notes #4

tags.bug: The player should no longer be able to freely lock/unlock locks without owning a key first (picking locks is still possible);
The player will no longer get ambushed while unconscious;
Liquid containers are now (finally) fully functional;
Dropping items on the ground in the open world will now correctly spawn a searchable object at the player's feet; (This currently doesn't work while the player is inside locations);
The "Drinking Buddies" quest should now correctly interact with the player's inventory
Gunter should now correctly retrieve the lance barrel from the player when the quest is complete

notes.title: Demo Patch Notes #3
notes.content:
Thank you for your continued support of our demo! 

The following fixes are save game compatible:
[list]
[*] Fixed a crash when stealing the last item in a stack.
[*] Fixed leather flask not holding liquids.
[*] Empty bottles are now containers and can now hold liquids; (Newly generated worlds will replace "Empty bottle" with "Glass bottle").
[*] Iron chest plate armor rating value changed from 20 to 5.
[*] Fixed scrap and stone pickaxe not functioning as pickaxes.
[*] Dryrock guards should no longer get stuck while patrolling.
[*] Added a screen shake toggle option in the Escape Menu.
[*] Crafting UI now correctly indicates the type and level of crafting/cooking station the player is using.
[*] Using the camp kit now deploys a camp with a bed, a stash and a campfire.
[/list]

The following fixes will require a new Player Profile:
[list]
[*]Fixed unique keys sometimes not being able to unlock the locks they were meant for (This will require a new world).
[/list]

Please keep sharing your feedback, bug reports and suggestions with us in our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2869850/discussions/1/]Steam subforum[/url] and [url=https://discord.gg/En7SRuZxFv]join our Discord[/url] to talk with other players.

notes.title: Demo Patch Notes #2
notes.content:
Thank you for playing our demo and reporting the bugs you've encountered. Below is a list of fixes we've implemented.

[h2]--TAVERNS--[/h2]
All Tavern fixes require a new save game.
[list]
[*] Taverns now contain a "Lodgings" sublocation.
[*] These have a high comfort modifier and always spawn a bed.
[*] Coins are now properly transfered to Tavern keeper's inventory when paying for a room (And can be stolen back).
[*] Fixed Bounty contracts not properly rewarding blueprints and mutation elixirs.
[*] Fixed Pact Broker's bounty board appearing while trading with the Pact Broker.
[*] Fixed a crash that could occur if the player talks to the Tavern Keeper outside of the Tavern.
[/list]
[h2]--LIQUIDS AND DRINKING--[/h2]
[list]
[*] The player can now properly gather liquids from any liquid source.
[*] Updated info message language to indicate that containers can't contain mismatched liquids (i.e. water and blood).
[*] Improved thirst-related info message language clarity.
[*] You can now drink liquids even when you're full (This is a temporary fix to allow emptying of liquid containers while item action selection is being worked on).
[/list]
[h2]--COMFORT SYSTEM--[/h2]
[list]
[*] Comfort system has been implemented, affects what % of fatigue the player can restore while sleeping.
[*] Comfort level is dynamically calculated based on various factors. Currently the most important factor is the location the player is currently in.
[*] Comfort level breakdown can be seen by hovering over the fatigue button on the world hud or character info screen.
[/list]
[h2]--OTHER--[/h2]
[list]
[*] World generation progress is now displayed.
[*] Made tar leaf smoke a craftable item and buffed it's fatigue reduction to -4 (blueprint can discovered by finding oily resin or rough thread).
[*] Smoked Mite Bites now reduce hunger by 24.
[*] Fleshmite spitters now properly drop Fleshmite Spitter Glands.
[*] Cooking on the Dryrock campfire is no longer considered a crime.
[*] Blueprint icons changed to item icons to make it easier to distinguish blueprints.
[*] Lockpicking should now work correctly.
[*] Updated lockpicking action tooltip to display "Devices" skill requirement.
[*] Added several missing item icons;.
[*] Added info messages when items are being given/received through dialogue.
[*] Added info message when player starts using a crafting/cooking station.
[*] Fixed several Quest dialogue related crashes.
[*] Fixed several mutation-related crashes.
[*] Fixed a crash when stealing an item while inventory is full.
[*] A number of other smaller bug fixes.
[/list]

[h2]--KNOWN ISSUES--[/h2]
We're aware of a number of known issues that we're looking into:
[list]
[*] Reloading an auto-save that's been made before a manual save makes it impossible to load a manual save while in-game, going back to the main menu and loading a manual save from the character profile screen should resolve this issue.
[*] The Tavern Keeper won't actually close the door to the room once 24 hours have passed after the player has bought access to lodgings.
[*] The player can repeatedly buy access to lodgings, this will do nothing other than make the Tavern Keeper richer.
[/list]

notes.title: Demo Patch Notes #1
notes.content:
Our first hot fix for the Lorn Vale demo is now live. Below you can see what we've fixed.

[h2]Fixes compatible with your save game[/h2]
[list]
[*] Auto-saves now occur after a successful combat encounter and not at the start of each dialogue.
[*] Fixed Shrine object missing visuals.
[*] Fixed rare world generation crash related to location party spawning
[*] Fixed Sand Crystal formation not properly rewarding Sand Crystals
[*] Fixed missing icon for Buried Crate Key.
[*] All item tooltips are now properly sized (Weight text no longer floats out of bounds).
[*] Melee weapon and armor tooltips now properly display several stats (based on the item).
[*] Bounty contract related crash fix.
[*] Sleeping bag blueprints are now auto-learned from cloth and Rough Thread
[*] Fixed a bug that disallowed the player to trade with anyone.
[*] Fixed crash related to Kerra's quest reward.
[/list]

[h2]The following fixes will require a new Player Profile[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed Rocksmith trait description.
[*] Fixed Rocksmith trait added blueprints not being unlearned when deselecting the trait in Character Creation.
[*] Sleeping bags are now purchasable from traders.
[/list]

Encountered a bug you don't see listed? We'll be continually reviewing bug reports and getting new fixes in so please bear with us.

~~
Chris and Roland
Gritty Games
